products.name: Avoma
products.note: Meeting intelligence AI; conversation analytics; coaching; revenue team data

profile_text.body:
Avoma is a software company headquartered in Fremont, California that describes itself as an all-in-one AI platform for note-taking, scheduling, and coaching. Its platform is aimed at revenue and sales teams and is designed to automate tasks including note-taking, email follow-ups, CRM data entry, meeting scheduling, lead qualification and routing, call scoring, and personalized coaching. The company describes potential time savings of 4 or more hours per week through these automations.

The core product, also called Avoma, falls in the notes, knowledge, and meetings category and includes meeting intelligence AI, conversation analytics, coaching tools, and revenue team data capabilities. The site also highlights features oriented toward sales performance, including deal and churn risk alerts, sales methodology tracking, pipeline inspection, and AI-driven win-loss analysis, with the stated goals of improving forecasting, quota attainment, and win rates.

The site's held facts show Avoma has a registered presence in California, with 175 associated law exposure entries in that state, though no specific litigation cases are recorded in the available data. No MCP servers or SEC or patent filings are noted in the held facts.
